subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
If receiver has an available power gain of 110 dB and 
a noise bandwidth of 10 MHz, the available output 
noise power of receiver is  
 
(a) 6.5 mW 
(b) 8.9 mW 
 
(c) 10.3 mV 
(d) 11.4  mV
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-07 (Noise In Communication).
